description: Length at FILE#/POINTER: keys of an object, items of an array, characters of a string. Also reads markdown (read only): FILE.md#/Heading is a section, #/Heading/_ its own text, #/Heading/0 a list item or table row, a list item key: value by its key, a section holding only a json block as JSON. More: aos/tools/json_len.json.
